summary: IDEAYA Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $300 million offering of common stock and pre-funded warrants on June 8, 2026. The offering is a routine capital raise under an existing shelf registration, with proceeds to the company after underwriting discounts. The last sale price was $28.29 per share. The filing does not involve a special situation such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or activist campaign; it is an ordinary equity issuance with no extraordinary terms or strategic event. The pre-funded warrants are a customary feature for at-the-market offerings. No special situation classification applies.
